title: PRD Supabase Tables Schema
description: Reference schema documenting the Supabase `prds` and `prd_stories` table structures. PRD data is accessed via helm-bridge plugin tools (helm_prd_list, helm_prd_get, etc.), not direct database queries.

prdStatus.description: PRD lifecycle status. Enforced via CHECK constraint in Supabase.

storyStatus.description: Story lifecycle status. Enforced via CHECK constraint in Supabase.

acceptanceCriterion.description: Single acceptance criterion within a story

text.description: What must be true for this criterion to pass

met.description: Whether this criterion has been verified

credentialRequirement.description: A credential the user must provide outside the agent system

status.description: Whether the credential has been provided

prdsTable.description: Supabase `prds` table — stores PRD metadata and content

org_id.description: Foreign key to orgs.id — the organization owning this PRD

repo_id.description: Foreign key to repos.id — the repository this PRD belongs to

created_by_user_id.description: Foreign key to users.id — the user who created this PRD

prd_id.description: Unique text identifier for the PRD (e.g., 'prd-user-auth'). Used for human-readable references.

total_stories.description: Total number of user stories in this PRD

created_at.description: Timestamp when the PRD was created (default: now())

updated_at.description: Timestamp of last update (auto-updated via moddatetime trigger)

started_at.description: Timestamp when work started on this PRD (status changed to in_progress)

completed_at.description: Timestamp when the PRD was completed or abandoned

draft_path.description: DEPRECATED: Legacy file path to draft PRD. Use content_markdown instead.

ready_path.description: DEPRECATED: Legacy file path to ready PRD. Use content_markdown instead.

json_path.description: DEPRECATED: Legacy file path to JSON PRD. Use content_markdown instead.

content_markdown.description: High-level summary/overview of the spec (what it is, why it matters). Detailed story content lives in prd_stories.content_markdown.

notes.description: Additional notes or context for this PRD

required_credentials.description: Credentials the user must provide outside the agent system. Spec-level: all credentials needed across all stories.

phases.description: Number of implementation phases for this PRD

current_story.description: ID of the story currently being worked on (e.g., 'US-003')

estimated_weeks.description: Estimated weeks to complete this PRD

stories_completed.description: DEPRECATED: Use completed_stories instead. Kept for backward compatibility.

planner_state.description: JSONB blob tracking planner agent workflow progress for cross-session recovery. Contains phase, storyProgress, gapAnalysis, qaDecisions, lastSessionId, and lastUpdatedAt.

phase.description: Current phase of the planner walkthrough

storyProgress.description: Tracks which stories have been reviewed

reviewed.description: Story IDs that have been reviewed (e.g., ['US-001', 'US-002'])

completed.description: Whether gap analysis has been completed

qaDecisions.description: Q&A decisions per story, keyed by story ID (e.g., {'US-001': {'1': 'A', '2': 'C'}})

lastSessionId.description: Session ID that last updated this state

prdStoriesTable.description: Supabase `prd_stories` table — stores individual user stories within a PRD

prd_id.description: Foreign key to prds.id (CASCADE delete — stories are deleted when PRD is deleted)

org_id.description: Foreign key to organizations.id — denormalized from parent PRD for RLS

session_id.description: Foreign key to sessions.id — the session currently working on this story (nullable)

content_markdown.description: Full story specification in markdown (detailed requirements, context, implementation notes). This is the primary content field for stories.

acceptance_criteria.description: JSONB array of acceptance criteria objects with {text, met} structure

phase.description: Which implementation phase this story belongs to

sort_order.description: Order of this story within the PRD for execution sequencing

estimated_hours.description: Estimated hours to complete this story

actual_hours.description: Actual hours spent on this story

required_credentials.description: Credentials this specific story depends on. Surfaced in Helm UI so user can act on them.

started_at.description: Timestamp when work started on this story

completed_at.description: Timestamp when this story was completed or skipped

created_at.description: Timestamp when the story was created (default: now())

updated_at.description: Timestamp of last update (auto-updated via moddatetime trigger)

planner_reviewed_at.description: Timestamp when planner walkthrough completed for this story. Set when the story passes through the per-story walkthrough and is approved.

prds.description: Reference to the prds table structure

prd_stories.description: Reference to the prd_stories table structure

x-supabase-notes.description: Implementation notes for the Supabase tables

prds: CHECK constraint on status: draft, ready, in_progress, completed, abandoned
prd_stories: CHECK constraint on status: pending, in_progress, completed, skipped
CASCADE delete when parent PRD is deleted

triggers.moddatetime: Both tables use moddatetime trigger to auto-update updated_at column

access.method: Use helm-bridge plugin tools (helm_prd_list, helm_prd_get, helm_prd_update, etc.)
access.note: Agents should NOT query Supabase directly. Use the provided helm_prd_* tools.
